notes.title: Chapter 3 Now Available!
notes.notes:
Chapter 3 of The Legend of Santa is available now with a spooky new villain! Kooky the Witch steals all of the Christmas presents and demands that Santa use her new delivery service instead of his sleigh.

Key Features of Chapter 3:

- A spooky world with six new levels.
- Halloween enemies and obstacles.
- Bottles of milk for invincibility hidden in many levels.
- Christmas Layaway.

Players can choose which chapter to play first! Start with Halloween or go straight to Christmas.

notes.title: Chapter 3 Preview
notes.notes:
Chapter 3 of The Legend of Santa is coming later this year with a spooky new villain! Check out a preview in the newly uploaded build to see the intro and play the first level! This is only a preview though - many more new enemies and obstacles await!

The Chapter 3 preview is selectable the Chapters menu.

Also included in the build are a few improvements and fixes:

- The hitbox for jumping hot chocolate bubbles is slightly smaller.
- Audio volume levels have been slightly adjusted.
- Fixed camera shifting that would occur rarely when respawning in multiplayer.

notes.title: Chapter 2 is Complete!
notes.notes:
Chapter 2 of The Legend of Santa is now available!

[list]
[*] Six brand-new levels
[*] Candy Cane powerup (also added to Chapter 1)
[*] Vertical camera movement in some levels
[*] New enemies and obstacles
[*] A continuation of Chapter 1's story
[/list]

We're excited to let our Early Access players try this new world before the official launch in November.

notes.title: Preview Chapter 2 of The Legend of Santa!
notes.notes:
We've just released a new build of The Legend of Santa. It includes a preview of Chapter 2, as well as a new powerup, and a custom soundtrack composed by Víctor Herrera Calvo.

Early Access players now have a chance to try out the new features and give feedback before the full game releases in November with an additional world and boss to continue Santa's story.

Some of the new features include:
[list]
[*] Custom soundtrack composed by Víctor Herrera Calvo
[*] Preview of Chapter 2
[*] Candy Cane Powerup
[*] New snow weather effect
[*] Vertical camera movement
[/list]
We encourage Early Access players to join our community and provide feedback!

notes.title: World 2 in Development!
notes.notes:
While Santa was making his way back after being shot out of the sky, the South Pole Troll's 2nd in command, Lieutenant Rockhopper, captured all of Santa's reindeer! This nasty penguin wants revenge against Santa for defeating his boss.

World 2 will feature an all-new world map, new levels, new enemies, and more!
